episodes.title: The Fort
episodes.summary: The Badlands' deadliest Clipper rescues a mysterious boy with a dark secret, who may know the way out.

episodes.title: Fist Like a Bullet
episodes.summary: M.K. finds refuge in an unlikely and dangerous place, while Sunny's loyalty is tested when Quinn tries to force him to commit an unspeakable act.

episodes.title: White Stork Spreads Wings
episodes.summary: As Sunny begins to train M.K., the boy struggles to learn discipline. Meanwhile, Quinn seeks retribution against The Widow and faces the consequences.

episodes.title: Two Tigers Subdue Dragons
episodes.summary: Sunny and M.K. try to figure out how to control the boy's power. Meanwhile, Quinn sets a dangerous parlay with a rival Baron to help fight The Widow.

episodes.title: Snake Creeps Down
episodes.summary: Quinn grows suspicious as Sunny secures his escape from the Fort; The Widow's decisions sets her on collision course with Sunny and M.K.

episodes.title: Hand of Five Poisons
episodes.summary: Sunny and M.K. fight to escape Quinn's grip once and for all; the Baron's enemies conspire to take him down and change the Badlands forever.

episodes.title: Tiger Pushes Mountain
episodes.summary: Six months after the Season 1 finale, Sunny finds a new foe, as well as a new, unexpected ally, while MK learns about his gift in a mysterious place.

episodes.title: Force of Eagle's Claws
episodes.summary: Sunny and Bajie struggle to stay alive; the Widow consolidates her power in the face of challenges.

episodes.title: Red Sun, Silver Moon
episodes.summary: Sunny and Bajie meet a dangerous foe who knows Sunny; the Widow prepares for a showdown; MK learns a secret.

episodes.title: Palm of the Iron Fox
episodes.summary: The Widow's fight for power lands her in a showdown with her enemies, who have joined forces against her; an old threat resurfaces.

episodes.title: Monkey Leaps Through Mist
episodes.summary: Sunny and Bajie get help from an unlikely source, for a price; the Widow considers a risk; MK enacts a dangerous plan.

episodes.title: Leopard Stalks in Snow
episodes.summary: Sunny and Bajie meet a friend, but must also confront an enemy from their past; the Widow makes an unholy alliance.

episodes.title: Black Heart, White Mountain
episodes.summary: Sunny confronts his inner demons, and his friends try to help; the Widow exacts revenge on her enemies.

episodes.title: Sting of the Scorpion's Tail
episodes.summary: Sunny plays a game which causes his friends to question his loyalty; the Widow discovers the existence of a new weapon.

episodes.title: Nightingale Sings No More
episodes.summary: Sunny relies on an unlikely person for help in defeating a foe; Bajie learns a shocking secret from his past.

episodes.title: Wolf's Breath, Dragon Fire
episodes.summary: Sunny faces the toughest showdown of his life; Bajie's loyalties are tested to their limits.

episodes.title: Enter the Phoenix
episodes.summary: Sunny returns to the Badlands, seeking a cure for his son Henry. The Widow and Chau wage a bloody civil war. A new threat emerges.

episodes.title: Moon Rises, Raven Seeks
episodes.summary: Sunny and Bajie seek help from Lydia. The Widow struggles to control M.K. Pilgrim seeks to establish a new order in the Badlands.

episodes.title: Leopard Snares Rabbit
episodes.summary: Sunny and Bajie go undercover on The Widow's frontlines, seeking passage to a possible cure for Henry; Tilda confronts The Widow.

episodes.title: Blind Cannibal Assassins
episodes.summary: Sunny and Bajie face off against a deadly new foe with a dark connection to Sunny's past; Chau enlists her brother in the fight against Pilgrim.

episodes.title: Carry Tiger to Mountain
episodes.summary: Sunny and Bajie seek help from a reclusive former Master; The Widow must confront a spectre from her past as Chau's slave.

episodes.title: Black Wind Howls
episodes.summary: Sunny and Bajie call in a favor from Bajie's past; The Widow interrogates an important captive who threatens her tentative peace with Pilgrim.

episodes.title: Dragonfly's Last Dance
episodes.summary: Sunny works with the River King to secure passage to Pilgrim's Fortress; The Widow faces mutiny from discontented troops.

episodes.title: Leopard Catches Cloud
episodes.summary: Sunny and Bajie arrive at Pilgrim's Fortress, only to face an angry M.K.; The Widow enlists Gaius; Moon and Lydia rally the troops.

episodes.title: Chamber of the Scorpion
episodes.summary: Sunny and Bajie face off with Pilgrim, who lays out his deadly plan for the Badlands; The Widow finds common ground with the Master.

episodes.title: Raven's Feather, Phoenix Blood
episodes.summary: Pilgrim leads the hunt for near-fatally wounded Sunny; The Widow confronts her inner demons in an attempt to restore her Gift.

episodes.title: The Boar and the Butterfly
episodes.summary: Sunny and Nix seek information that could destroy Pilgrim; The Widow and Bajie team up with the Master; M.K. leads Pilgrim to a great source of power.

episodes.title: Cobra Fang, Panther Claw
episodes.summary: The Widow and Baron Chau finally face off; M.K. and Pilgrim grow their forces at the Monastery; Sunny and Bajie discover a new foe, the Black Lotus.

episodes.title: Black Lotus, White Rose
episodes.summary: Sunny discovers an important figure from his past is working with the Black Lotus; The Widow, Gaius and Tilda bring an end to the bloody civil war.

episodes.title: Curse of the Red Rain
episodes.summary: Sunny, Bajie and Kannin journey back into the Badlands; The Widow makes a risky play against Pilgrim, bringing Cressida and Lydia into the crossfire.

episodes.title: Requiem for the Fallen
episodes.summary: Sunny, Bajie and Gaius seek out an unlikely ally in the fight against Pilgrim; Cressida has a disturbing revelation; The Widow questions her future.

episodes.title: Seven Strike as One
episodes.summary: Sunny, the Widow and Bajie lead the charge against Pilgrim, as he attempts to gain ultimate control of the Badlands; M.K. seeks revenge on the Widow.
